settings.agenticRAGDesc: Allows LLM to proactively pause and query cross-chapter FTS5, L2 Character Graph, or Web when context is ambiguous. Disable to save tokens and maximize speed.

settings.autoProcessDesc: AI Shadow Critic automatically arbitrates based on Style Guide and context without pausing. Ideal for unattended overnight batch translation.

skill_style_scout.name: Style Scout
skill_style_scout.desc: Analyzes author narrative rhythm, lexical cadence, and stylistic density to maintain voice continuity.

skill_entity_extraction.name: Entity & Relationship Extractor
skill_entity_extraction.desc: Detects characters, honorifics, faction hierarchies, and dynamic relationships from chapter context.

skill_literary_translator.name: Literary Translator
skill_literary_translator.desc: Produces faithful, highly expressive literary translations with natural cadence, anti-translationese de-calquing, idiom awareness, and clean typography.

skill_shadow_critic.name: Shadow Critic
skill_shadow_critic.desc: Inspects drafts in real time to catch word-by-word translationese, idiom errors, pronoun drift, glossary compliance, and punctuation flaws.

skill_agentic_researcher.name: Agentic Researcher
skill_agentic_researcher.desc: Proactively invokes tools to lookup character relations, world lore, past context, and web references when uncertain.

skill_foreign_sanitizer.name: Foreign Sanitizer
skill_foreign_sanitizer.desc: Sanitizes residual foreign script, fixes irregular punctuation, corrects capitalization, and enforces typography standards.
